values.binNote: No RakanR data value carries the 75% slow strength; it is a tooltip-only percentage not read by any listed calculation.

mechanics.claim: Rakan deals damage to enemies he collides with during the dash, charming and slowing them; this cannot affect the same enemy more than once.
mechanics.quote: he deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he collides with and {{tip|charm|charms}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 75% for a duration. This cannot affect the same enemy more than once.

mechanics.claim: During The Quickness, Rakan cannot basic attack enemy champions he did not collide with, unless the attack was queued before activation.
mechanics.quote: During The Quickness, '''Rakan''' cannot basic attack enemy champions he did not collide with, unless the attack command was inputted before the ability was activated.

mechanics.claim: Colliding with an enemy champion extends the duration by 0.25 seconds, once per champion.
mechanics.quote: Colliding with an enemy {{tip|champion}} extends ''The Quickness' ''duration by {{fd|0.25}} seconds, which can occur once per champion.

mechanics.claim: On the first enemy champion collision, Rakan gains an additional 75% bonus movement speed that decays over time.
mechanics.quote: When '''Rakan''' collides with his first enemy champion, he gains an additional {{as|75% '''bonus''' movement speed}} that decays after {{fd|0.5}} seconds by 20% every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, then by 15% after decaying by 60% over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.

mechanics.claim: Grand Entrance is disabled during R's cast time but can be buffered; Gleaming Quill and Battle Dance are usable.
mechanics.quote: ''Grand Entrance'' is disabled but can still be buffered. [[File: Gleaming Quill.png|20px|link=]] ''Gleaming Quill'' and [[File: Battle Dance.png|20px|link=]] ''Battle Dance'' are usable.
